reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 78,682.0, today's low. A settled close underneath a pocket that has already been flushed once means the replacement cohort is being flushed too, and the reference becomes the 78,650.0 low of 04 September and then the 4H EMA100 at 77,332.52.

decisionBox.changed: Morning held ADD and morning's structure broke. Its reduceIf at 79,185.0 fired on the settled 15:00 UTC close of 78,834.1 and confirmed on the 16:00 UTC close of 79,031.0; its invalidatesAt at 79,000.0 was breached by 318 points on a 78,682.0 low. The stance moves from ADD to REDUCE, and the reason is not the price - it is what the price broke through. Morning identified the 1H EMA200 at 79,324.50 as the last moving average of any timeframe price was still holding. That has now gone: spot at 79,180.7 sits below the 1H EMA20 at 79,441.38, the EMA50 at 79,621.58, the EMA100 at 79,534.54 and the EMA200 at 79,311.17, all four. The day has printed a lower low at 78,682.0 against this morning's 79,000.0 as well as a lower high at 79,648.1 against 79,927.3, which is a complete lower-high-lower-low sequence on the hourly rather than a range. And the positioning condition that capped morning's add size deteriorated again over the same five and a half hours: open interest rose 2.60 percent from 2,131,493,483 to 2,186,965,596 USD while price fell 293.2 points, and the OKX 1H long/short account ratio climbed from 1.11 to 1.17 straight through a 1.09 million dollar long flush. Three sessions running, more leverage has arrived on every decline and it has arrived long. That is the argument for taking a small amount off rather than putting more on. What holds this to REDUCE instead of EXIT is the daily, which is untouched: price is above all four daily EMAs, 2,429.9 points over the EMA20 at 76,750.62, with daily RSI at 62.94.

liquidation.note: 1,086,427 USD across 89 filled OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP liquidations, 100 percent LONG-side, realized between 15:37 and 17:43 UTC at today's 78,682.0 low. This is measured realized-liquidation data, not an estimate. It is the second seven-figure long flush of the same calendar day - the first was 1,220,668 USD at 79,000.0 inside the 07:00 UTC hour - and it means roughly 2.3 million dollars of long leverage has been forcibly closed in BTC-USDT swap alone since midnight. The pocket has been struck and price rejected 498.7 points off it, so this is spent fuel rather than resting fuel. What makes it a magnet anyway is that open interest rose 2.60 percent THROUGH the flush: the cohort that died has already been replaced and is sitting above the same level.

28,594 USD across 10 filled liquidations, all SHORT-side. Shorts that pressed the break of the 79,000 handle and were caught on the reclaim. It is the only short-side cluster of any size in the window and it is 38 times smaller than the long cluster underneath it, which is the whole positioning story in one comparison.
1,377 USD on a single SHORT-side fill. Essentially nothing. There is no short leverage of consequence anywhere above spot, which is exactly what a 1.17 account ratio and positive funding describe.

Untouched and this is what caps the downside case. Today's daily candle is 80,341.4 open, 80,441.4 high, 78,682.0 low, 79,162.6 current - a 1.47 percent down day inside a structure that has printed 82,285.0 as its recent extreme. calibration.rollingRecord: Morning held ADD with reduceIf 79,185.0, addIf 79,765.0 and invalidatesAt 79,000.0. The reduce fired and the invalidation broke; the add did not fire. The reduce triggered on the settled 15:00 UTC close of 78,834.1, 350.9 points below the trigger, and confirmed on the 16:00 UTC close of 79,031.0. The invalidation was breached by 318 points on a 78,682.0 low inside the same hour. The addIf at 79,765.0 missed by 116.9 points - the session high was 79,648.1. Acting on the reduce helped cleanly this time: spot is now 293.2 points below the morning mark and a trader who reduced at 79,185.0 is 4.3 points better than spot with the cash to buy the 78,650 shelf.
calibration.note: Three sessions running the levels have been mechanically correct and the directional stance has been early - endday was early, midnight was early, morning was early. Today the record breaks in the other direction: morning's reduce level fired and following it was right. The pattern now has a name. This range pays the level-reader and punishes the position-taker, and the specific tell has been positioning rather than price: open interest has risen on every single decline this week (2.115bn to 2.131bn to 2.187bn) while the long/short account ratio walked 1.11 to 1.17 straight through two seven-figure long flushes in one day. When leverage rebuilds long through its own liquidation, the next flush tends to come from lower. That argues for respecting the reduce triggers and sizing adds smaller, which is what this session does.
